evidence.label: 描述任务、问题或评测环境
evidence.excerpt: Medical vision-language models (VLMs) show strong performance in radiology report generation (RRG) and medical visual question answering (Med-VQA), producing free-form clinical descriptions and answers from medical images.

evidence.label: 报告基线或多个模型的评测
evidence.excerpt: Across four datasets spanning RRG and Med-VQA, CLEAR outperforms state-of-the-art hallucination detection baselines across multiple medical and general-purpose VLMs.
